notes: Visible table (1 header row + 4 data rows = 5 rows, 3 cols: Description/Qty/Amount) drawn with vector rules — an outer border via `re`+S plus internal grid lines via `m`/`l`+S — and a right-aligned Amount column. This is the `structure` dimension baseline: today's convertPdf reconstructs absolutely-positioned text spans with NO <table> element at all, so it will score ~0 on structure even though every phrase (including the totals row) is present in the extracted text. That gap is intentional and documented — the semantic PDF reconstructor is expected to raise it later.
